subject: Medivance procurement path and pilot terms — next steps
messages:
From: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 20 Jun 2026 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Medivance procurement path and pilot terms — recap from discovery

Team — quick recap from today’s discovery with Medivance (Karen + Rajesh). High-level: strong product fit for claims triage (they care about latency and audit logs), interested in a 3-month pilot tied to a small production slice. Key notes below and asks where I need quick input.

What they told us
- Use case: automated triage for incoming claims, expected peak 45 RPS during business hours, average 6k tokens/day to start.
- Decision makers: Karen Wu (Sr Dir, Data & Analytics) is the technical sponsor, Rajesh Patel (IT procurement lead) will own procurement, and CFO (TBD) is the economic approver.
- Compliance: will require SOC 2 evidence, data retention policy, and network architecture diagram.
- Procurement timeline: 6–8 weeks once we hand over procurement packet.

Request from Medivance
- Pilot exceptions: they asked if we can do a 3-month pilot with a reduced SLA (99.5%) and a 35% pilot discount to prove value before committing. They also want a short-term addendum that limits token volume for the pilot.

My asks
1) Pricing lead: Ben — can you run a quick sanity check on a 35% pilot discount to see margin impact (assume 50k tokens/month cap)?
2) Legal/procurement: Laura — can you confirm who on your side needs to sign to accept a pilot addendum vs full contract?
3) Escalation: Marcus — would leadership ok a temporary SLA concession for pilot if we limit exposure and require a rollback to standard SLA on full contract?

Attachments: I gave them our term sheet (redwood_mvp_term_sheet_v1.pdf) and asked for their procurement template.

I’ll follow up with an outbound recap to Karen + Rajesh and try to lock the procurement contacts and CFO identity.

— Priya
Priya Natarajan
Enterprise Sales (West) | Redwood Inference
priya.natarajan@redwood.com
From: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Karen Wu <karen.wu@medivance.com>, Rajesh Patel <rajesh.patel@medivance.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Jun 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up & procurement contacts — Medivance pilot proposal

Hi Karen / Rajesh — thanks again for the time on Friday. Short recap and next steps from our side.

Recap
- Pilot scope: claims triage for inbound POC, ~50k tokens/month cap, 3-month pilot.
- Tech asks we can provide quickly: SOC 2 summary, data retention policy, architecture diagram, and a small SLA addendum for the pilot window.
- Business ask: team requested a pilot discount (roughly 35%) to shorten evaluation friction and confirm value.

Immediate asks (can we get these this week?)
1) Procurement contact: please confirm the right person at procurement (name + email) and the legal rep who would review a pilot addendum.
2) Economic approver: who is the CFO or exec who approves pilots with revenue impact?
3) Procurement template: please share your procurement/contract template so we can pre-fill.

Attached: redwood_mvp_term_sheet_v1.pdf (term-level summary for pilot).

If helpful I can book a short 30-minute procurement walkthrough with Rajesh and your legal contact to walk the redlines we expect. Proposed times: Wed 23rd 10:00–10:30 PT or Thu 24th 11:00–11:30 PT.

Thanks — looking forward to moving this forward.

Best,
Priya
From: Karen Wu <karen.wu@medivance.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>, Rajesh Patel <rajesh.patel@medivance.com>
Date: Wed, 24 Jun 2026 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up & procurement contacts — Medivance pilot proposal

Priya — thanks for the clear recap. Quick answers:
- Procurement lead: Rajesh Patel (I cc’d him above) — he’ll own the template and internal gating.
- Legal reviewer: procurement@medivance.com (internal counsel will triage).
- Economic approver: CFO (Anita Rao) — I’ll intro you if we proceed to contract.

Procurement notes:
- We will need SOC 2 type II evidence, a plain-English data retention summary, and an architecture/network diagram that shows where tokens and logs are stored. Can you attach those?
- For the pilot: procurement prefers to avoid changing SLA language, but will consider a timeboxed addendum if it’s limited and we agree clear rollback criteria.

I attached the template procurement doc (Medivance_procurement_template.docx) and a short checklist (Medivance_security_requirements.xlsx) showing the documents our security team will require.

Rajesh — can you propose times for a procurement walkthrough? We’d like to do it next week if possible.

Thanks,
Karen
Karen Wu
Sr. Director, Data & Analytics | Medivance
karen.wu@medivance.com
From: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 29 Jun 2026 11:17:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: ask for pilot discount + temporary SLA concession approval (Medivance MDV-2381)

Ben / Laura — looping you in with the procurement asks from Medivance and requesting internal clearance on two items so we can proceed to the procurement walkthrough next week:

Proposed pilot terms (Priya’s recommendation)
- Length: 3 months
- Token cap: 50k tokens / month maximum (hard cap)
- Discount: 30% off list for the pilot (I recommend 30% instead of 35% to keep margin buffer)
- SLA: temporary concession to 99.5% for the pilot only, with clause to revert to standard SLA (99.9%) on full purchase; require notice and a maximum exposure cap of $X (TBD by finance).

Rationales
- Limits our exposure with a hard token cap and explicit rollback to standard SLA.
- Shorter pilot reduces procurement friction.
- We preserve pricing leverage on full contract.

Specific asks
- Ben: confirm the pilot pricing sheet (attached pilot_pricing_sheet.xlsx) — does 30% keep us profitable under the token cap?
- Laura: can legal prepare a 1-page pilot addendum template we can present to Medivance that includes the SLA timebox and rollback language? Also confirm required Security & SOC evidence we can provide immediately.

I’ll be on the procurement walkthrough with Rajesh next Tue 07 Jul 2026 10:00 PT (tentative) — want to have internal approvals before that meeting.

Thanks,
Priya
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Internal: ask for pilot discount + temporary SLA concession approval (Medivance MDV-2381)

Thanks for the summary, Priya. I approve proceeding with the proposed pilot terms with the following conditions:

1) Hard token cap must be implemented in the billing pipeline and enforced at the API layer — no exceptions.
2) Finance (Ben), please define the maximum monetary exposure (dollar cap) for the SLA concession; keep it <= $5k for the pilot.
3) Legal (Laura), provide the 1-page pilot addendum and confirm we can produce SOC 2 summary + architecture diagram within 3 business days.
4) Sales: Priya, include a clause that pilot discount expires on signing of the full contract.

If all the above are confirmed, Priya — proceed to schedule the procurement walkthrough and share the draft addendum with Medivance in advance.

— Marcus
Marcus Lin
Head of Sales Operations | Redwood Inference
